replacements.from: 1) Copy/Paste: Copy any layer or frame in Figma and paste it onto the canvas in Pencil. Btw: Images are not included.

replacements.from: A new version has been downloaded and is ready to install.
replacements.to: 新版本已下载完成，随时可以安装。

replacements.from: A snapshot is a self-contained ZIP of this design and all referenced dependencies so it can be reopened on another machine. It will include:

replacements.from: Add frames to the canvas to see them here as slides. Frames appear in document order and can be reordered by dragging.

replacements.from: Allow agents to run without permission prompts. This gives full file system and command access.

replacements.from: Ask Claude to generate code from your designs (Keep Pencil desktop app running). Claude Code will be able to access selections, components, variables, etc.

replacements.from: Layers will be exported as pages in a single PDF. Pages are sorted in the order they were selected.

replacements.from: Visit your billing settings to review available plans and upgrade.
replacements.to: 访问您的账单设置以查看可用方案并升级。

replacements.from: via MCP from other tools, like Claude Code CLI. This has some advantages and it's great when exporting to code. But for designing on the canvas, the built-in agents are more convenient + you get parallel design agents and loops.

replacements.to: 启动时，MCP 会自动为所选 CLI 工具完成配置。
提示：为什么要使用组件

replacements.from: Components let you maintain consistency across your designs. Edit the main component once and every instance updates automatically.
replacements.to: 组件可以让你的设计保持一致：只需编辑一次主组件，所有实例都会自动更新。

replacements.from: Components serve as the foundation for building design systems.
replacements.to: 组件是构建设计系统的基石。

replacements.from: Hide sidebar when Layers are open
replacements.to: 图层打开时自动隐藏侧边栏

replacements.from: Animations & effects (turn off to save GPU/CPU)
replacements.to: 动画与效果（关闭可节省 GPU/CPU）

replacements.from: Include HTML metadata when importing pages
replacements.to: 导入页面时包含 HTML 元数据

replacements.from: Select an element to create a component.
replacements.to: 选择要创建为组件的元素。

replacements.from: Any standard design element — a frame, shape, or text — can be converted into a reusable component.
replacements.to: 任何标准设计元素——画框、形状或文本——都可以转换为可复用的组件。

replacements.from: The element becomes your component origin, marked with a magenta bounding box. You can also create nested components for more complex structures.
replacements.to: 元素将成为组件的原点，并以洋红色边框标记。您还可以创建嵌套组件来构建更复杂的结构。

replacements.from: Copy the component origin on the canvas to create an instance. Instances are marked with a violet bounding box when selected.
replacements.to: 复制画布上的组件原点即可创建实例。实例在选中时会以紫色边框标记。
